exposure: women with a history of previous CS
women with SB caused by placenta disorders
women with SB caused by abruptio placentae
cohort: 783 women with stillbirth (fetus non-viable >22 weeks' gestation) in Emilia Romagna, Italy between January 2014 and December 2020.
finding: The method of induction of labor and the mode of delivery in case of stillbirth were related to placenta disorders, which were a significant factor leading to emergency CS.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was the most common mode of delivery (84.3%), while cesarean section was performed in 15.7% of cases.
